name: MonarchLanguageSelect
title: LanguageSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) over BCP 47 tags named with java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag and getDisplayName
summary: A searchable picker of a language whose value is its BCP 47 tag, each language shown under its own name with its name in the interface language below.
whenToUse: For the language of the interface, of emails, of a document or of a translation, when the value to store is a language tag.
whenNotToUse: To follow the device language, use the system per-app language setting (AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales or the Android 13 app language screen) instead of a picker of your own.
api: @Composable fun MonarchLanguageSelect(selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, locale: Locale? = null, languages: List<String>? = null, priority: List<String> = emptyList(), labelStyle: MonarchLanguageSelectLabelStyle = MonarchLanguageSelectLabelStyle.Endonym, presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, showTag: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchLanguageSelectLabels = MonarchLanguageSelectLabels())
class MonarchLanguageSelectLabels(label: String? = null, suggested: String? = null, all: String? = null, empty: String? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen BCP 47 tag, such as "pt-BR", or null. It is compared in its canonical form.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the chosen canonical tag, or null when the selection is cleared.

options.name: locale
options.description: The interface language: the second name of each row and the sort order use it. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: languages
options.description: Limits the list to these tags, such as the languages the product is translated into. null lists about 80 widely used languages.

options.name: priority
options.description: Tags listed first under "Suggested" while nothing is typed, such as the device's languages.

options.name: labelStyle
options.description: Which name each row shows first: the language's own ("Deutsch") or the interface language's ("German").

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight languages, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: showTag
options.description: Shows the tag at the end of each row.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection. Hidden while searching.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field while something is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the label "Language", "Suggested", "All languages", "No languages match" and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen language's label, or the placeholder (or the floating label) while nothing is chosen.

states.name: open
states.description: The bottom sheet (or, for eight options or fewer, the menu) lists the options; while nothing is typed the suggested ones come first under their heading.

states.name: searching
states.description: Typing filters the list, best matches first, without headings; when nothing matches the list says so.

states.name: error
states.description: The field has the danger outline and the message below it, and the message is the field's error for TalkBack.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the disabled colors and does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: MonarchTextField's colors, a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error; the sheet is on the surface color, second lines, hints and headings are muted text and the chosen row's radio mark is the accent strong color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchCombobox, so long lists open a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field instead of the web's popover. Names come from java.util.Locale.getDisplayName, which names regional variants with the region in brackets ("English (United Kingdom)") where the web's Intl.DisplayNames says "British English". The web marks each endonym with its lang attribute so screen readers pronounce it in its language; MonarchComboboxOption takes plain strings, so TalkBack reads every name with the interface voice. The value is controlled only. iOS has no LanguageSelect yet; the name is the planned shared one.
accessibility: The field is MonarchCombobox's Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value and the expand state; double tap opens the list.

Every row is read with its label, second line and hint, and the chosen row is selected with a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color; in the sheet each row is a radio button at least 48dp high.
The headings over suggested and other entries are headings; the no-match message is a polite live region.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text.
Endonyms are read in the interface language's voice; the second line gives the name in the interface language, so the row is understandable either way.
edgeCases: Tags are canonicalised ("EN-us" becomes "en-US"); invalid tags and repeats are dropped from the list.
A selected tag that is not in the list is still listed.
When both names are the same (English in an English interface) the row has no second line.
Searching matches either name, the tag and the English name.

examples.title: Endonyms with suggestions
examples.template:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    selected = language,
    onSelectedChange = { language = it },
    languages = listOf({{languages.0}}, {{languages.1}}, {{languages.2}}, {{languages.3}}, {{languages.4}}, {{languages.5}}, {{languages.6}}, {{languages.7}}, {{languages.8}}),
    priority = listOf({{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}),
    showTag = true,
    helperText = {{description}},
    labels = MonarchLanguageSelectLabels(label = {{label}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    selected = language,
    onSelectedChange = { language = it },
    languages = listOf("ar", "de", "en", "es", "fr", "hi", "ja", "pt-BR", "zh-Hans"),
    priority = listOf("en", "es"),
    showTag = true,
    helperText = "Each language is listed in its own name.",
    labels = MonarchLanguageSelectLabels(label = "Interface language"),
)

examples.title: The product's translations by interface name
examples.code:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    selected = translation,
    onSelectedChange = { translation = it },
    languages = listOf("en", "fr", "pt-BR", "ja"),
    labelStyle = MonarchLanguageSelectLabelStyle.Localized,
    showTag = true,
)
